Keys and values must be passed as strings and not contain any personally identifiable information (PII).

Min keys: `0`
Max keys: `50`


> Note: Nested keys are not supported.
metadata.title: Metadata

payment_id.description:

reference_id.description:
A user-defined identifier for this refund, typically used to associate the refund with a record in an external system.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `1024`

status.description:
The step of the refund processing lifecycle that this refund is currently at.

- `AUTHORIZED`
- `CAPTURED`
- `VOIDED`
- `DECLINED`
status.title: RefundStatus

updated_at.description: When this refund was last updated, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

cash_app_dispute_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each dispute changed in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_new_dispute_trigger.description: Runs for each new dispute in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs for each new refund in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_payment_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each payment changed in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

cash_app_refund_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each refund changed in Cash App. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
